children: 5N Plus is positioned to become only qualified domestic U.S. supplier of gallium arsenide electro-optical components. Desjardin analyst Frederic Tremblay notes the specialty materials company was selected by the U.S. Department of War to receive $7.3 million to establish domestic production of gallium arsenide components for defense applications at its Utah facility. Currently, U.S. defense contractors rely on foreign suppliers. Tremblay says that this could also open the door to future production of gallium arsenide components and other advanced semiconductor materials for other defense and space applications. "This expands VNP's long-term optionality by broadening its addressable market and strengthening its positioning within critical western supply chains," he says. Shares are up 6.5% to C$26.55. (adriano.marchese@wsj.com)
